name: Streamline Car
summary: The car as a teardrop. A smooth, rounded body with the mudguards merged into the sides, a sloped tail, a raked grille and bands of chrome that show speed.

philosophy.core_thesis: A fast car looks like a drop of water: one smooth shell with no break in the line, from the grille to the tail.
design_principles: Round the nose, and set the grille at a rake of 10 to 20 degrees.
Merge the mudguards into the body, so that the flank has one unbroken curve.
Slope the tail in a long taper, or end it in a short fastback of about 30 degrees.
Hide the headlamps in the wings or behind the grille, and cover the rear wheel with a skirt.
Run two or three horizontal chrome bands along the body, to show speed.
Divide the windscreen in two and slope it back by 25 to 30 degrees.
Set the cabin with a dashboard of Bakelite and painted metal, and mohair cloth on the seats.
anti_patterns: Square corners and a flat roof
A bright wire wheel with no cover
Tail fins on the rear wings

silhouette.shape: A teardrop: a rounded nose, a body that swells at the middle and a long tail that narrows to a point. The wheels sit inside the body line.
silhouette.line: A smooth curve from the grille over the roof to the tail, with chrome speed lines along the flank.
silhouette.fit: The cabin is closed and rounded; the doors follow the curve of the body, and the windows are narrow and curved.
silhouette.proportion: Length to height about 3 to 1; the roof is 1.5 to 1.6 m; the tail tapers over 25 to 30 percent of the car.
rules: Cover the rear wheels with a fender skirt.
Slope the windscreen and the rear window to match the line of the roof.
Use a waterfall grille: tall, narrow, with fine vertical or horizontal bars.
Pair a body of one colour with a chrome band, or two soft tones split at the waist.

fabrics.rule: Use pressed steel in big smooth panels. Use chrome for the speed line and Bakelite for the knobs and the wheel. Use a soft mohair velvet or wool cloth in the cabin.

methods: big body panels pressed in steel dies
streamlined shape tested in a wind tunnel
chrome plating of grille, bands and bumpers
Bakelite moulding of knobs and steering wheel
two-tone spray paint with a masked line
construction.closures: Doors hinged at the front or rear edge, flush chrome handles and a recessed latch; a hidden boot lid.
construction.details: A chrome waterfall grille, a hood ornament, teardrop lamps in the wings, fender skirts, a split windscreen and a clock set into the dashboard.

surface.pattern: Plain body colour, split by a chrome band; striped cloth or plain mohair in the cabin, and an engine-turned dashboard panel.
surface.gloss: Cellulose or enamel paint at 80–90 GU; chrome at more than 90 GU; Bakelite at 40–60 GU.
surface.wear: Chrome pits and the paint crazes; Bakelite darkens; the cloth wears first at the seat edge.

palette.strategy: Soft, rich body colours, one or two, a bright chrome speed line and a warm cabin of mohair and Bakelite.

making.scale: Mass-made in thousands, from a few designs; the form comes from an industrial design studio, not from a coachbuilder.
making.signs: Fender skirts, a waterfall grille, chrome speed lines on the flank and a roof that flows into the tail.

pieces.form: Closed teardrop saloon with a sloped tail and covered rear wheels
Fastback coupe with a hidden boot and a split windscreen
Chrome waterfall grille and speed bands on the flank
Painted metal dashboard with a Bakelite fascia and a clock
Wide bench seat in mohair velvet with a plain pleat

emotion.target_response: A sense of speed and a modern future: the viewer sees one smooth shell that already moves while it stands.

use_cases: a world's fair or a 1930s retro poster
a film set in the 1930s or 1940s
an image prompt for an Art Deco car
an industrial design lesson on streamline form
avoid_when: the brief wants a coachbuilt formal luxury car
the brief wants fins and a lot of chrome
the brief wants a sharp, flat-sided shape

modifiers.how: Add a tail fin, a wide chrome grille, a wrap-around windscreen and two-tone paint.
Lower the roof, shorten the overhangs, and trim the chrome to a thin line.

ornament_level.note: The ornament is the line: chrome bands and a grille, with no applied pattern.
